content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fort Walton Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education—no work experience necessary. This makes CAPM ideal for Fort Walton Beach professionals in defense contracting, government services, and healthcare who are new to project management and want to formalize their knowledge quickly.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format covers the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world scenarios. You'll learn asynchronously on your schedule while interacting with active certified practitioners in structured sessions designed for working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After coursework completion, apply directly to PMI with your education documentation and pay the required CAPM exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process so you understand each requirement and timeline before you submit.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. The exam tests your grasp of initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and closing project activities. Schedule your proctored exam when you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning CAPM, renew every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or formal training. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing commitment to project management excellence in your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
